% Generated by paper/make_tables.py. Do not edit.
{\footnotesize\texttt{rank}} & Rank by length among graded loci (grades A-D); empty for excluded rows (grade X). \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{accession}} & Representative record: the longest live model of the locus (NCBI Protein, UniProtKB or UniParc UPI accession). \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{organism}} & Organism as given by the record. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{superkingdom}} & Eukaryota, Bacteria or Archaea (NCBI taxonomy). \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{length\_aa}} & Length of the representative sequence in amino acids. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{grade}} & Final grade after all stages: A supported full-length model; B supported in parts; C no contradiction and no support line; D contradicted by at least one check; X excluded (synthetic or patent, partial, or no live record). \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{grade\_stage1}} & Grade after the sequence and locus checks only (Stage 1), before RNA-seq and source-read evidence. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{best\_grade\_other\_models\_at\_locus}} & Best grade among all models merged into this row (isoforms, copies, duplicate records). \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{same\_gene\_other\_assemblies}} & Near-identical copies of the gene in other assemblies (support line S2), merged into this row. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{same\_gene\_other\_records}} & Other records of the same gene in the same organism (haplotypes, GenBank and RefSeq versions, isoforms; $\geq$ 90 \% shared 10-mers), merged into this row and not counted as independent support. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{databases}} & Databases holding the representative sequence. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{evidence}} & One-line summary of the checks that decided the grade: contradiction rule (D1-D5), support lines (S1-S4, S6 peptides), RNA-seq intron support, source-read verdicts per assembly, peptide evidence. \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{still\_missing}} & Evidence that would be needed to raise or confirm the grade, including whether PRIDE lists projects for the species (keyword match only; PXD025008 and PXD060105 were reanalysed). \\
{\footnotesize\texttt{locus\_key}} & Locus identifier: NCBI GeneID, contig region, MD5 of a sequence without locus, or 'copies:' for merged copy sets. \\
